rules.rule: Waits and readiness checks must work for every supported language server, not only rust-analyzer, and must stop at once when the server process dies.
A JSON-RPC response that carries an error member is a failure; never report it as success.
Build file URIs with percent-encoding, and match workspace roots on whole path segments so a sibling like /work/app-extra never matches /work/app.
Native process I/O must have deadlines and bounded buffers, check realloc results, and free everything on failure paths.
